bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 1 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Executioner of the Gods
abilities.text: If this threat rolls a Wrath Critical as part of an attack, the target may suffer the Savage Attack critical hit as default.

abilities.name: Quicksilver Strike
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Blessed Blade Takes the Initiative and can Charge up to 20m.

abilities.name: Bodyguard
abilities.text: When a Threat with the CHAOS CULT Keywords within 6m of this Threat is targeted by an attack, this Threat may interpose itself as a reaction and become the new target for the attack.
